steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: *sigh*... *siiiigh*...

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: What are you sighing for? Does your tooth hurt?

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: It's my HEAD that hurts!

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: If you have too much time on your hands, go count the cabbage stock for winter.

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: Hey—

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: Are you going or not?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Going where, when the sun hasn't even climbed above the rooftops?

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: Don't play the fool with me! The city is almost empty. Why do you stay?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Almost means it's not totally empty. Travelers, soldiers on duty, they all need to eat.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Besides, we have someone right here in the restaurant.

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: She doesn't count!

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: If you don't go now, there's nothing I can do when the Sui Regulator hears of her visit to this place.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: I just put the fowlbeast on the grill, and there are another four or five dishes still to be served. There's no rush.

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: Oh, you're just—!

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Stop worrying so much, first thing in the morning. Go open the door, if you really have too much time on your hands. It's business as usual for breakfast hours!

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: You're bold as a boulder, you know that?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: What else can I do?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: If you're sleepy, go to bed. If you're hungry, eat something. Who knows when someone might suddenly miss a certain taste? A customer could show up at any moment—

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: See? A customer just showed up.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Take a seat you like! Only the breakfast menu is available right now—

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Oh, it's you.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: I'm not sure what you're asking... I run this place. What else would I be doing?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: You 'people' just keep getting more and more ridiculous.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Why the rudeness? Insulting the chef before you've taken a single bite?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Keep this up, and I'll kick you out. Even my patience has its limits.
The frosty individual walks into the restaurant and sits down at the table beside Yu.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: What flavors does Savors at Yu's savor?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: All of them, of course, from sweet to sour to salty to spicy.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: And to get the smell of fire and smoke all over yourself... do you like this?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Of course. Can't be a good cook, if you don't like to cook.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: I can't speak to anything else, but I'm pretty confident in my cooking.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: I could make a couple of dishes for you. On the house.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: One has to taste different flavors in life. Isn't it a waste to be obsessed with a single flavor?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Ah... but I guess I can't really use these words to persuade you.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: They say, 'he who tells others to forgive and forget will be struck by lightning.' Besides, I guess the bad blood between you is pretty thick.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: I understand how you feel. Really!

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: You have every reason to hate Yan, hate humanity, hate It... and I suppose it's not out of the question for the hatred to last a thousand years.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: But if you keep hating and hating, with nothing to do but let the hate destroy you... is it really worth it?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: You remind me of my brother, come to think of it...

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: You're not afraid of me at all.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Why should I be?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Beggars, mandarins, even the gods in Heaven and the Feranmuts of legend, they're all customers when they walk into this restaurant.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: You're different from the others...

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: You're unusual, even among your... kind.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: You don't look concerned at all, even when your life is on the line.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: *sigh*... I guess I've gotten used to living in fear. It's been this way for a century.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Your timing isn't great, I have to say. You would really have had a treat, if you had come when the ingredients were still fresh in the kitchen.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Sometimes, all it takes to change your mood is a nice, hot meal. Maybe the things that seemed impossible will solve themselves.

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: The buns are ready, chef, but our breakfast sign is gone! Did Blaze—

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: There's actually a customer? At this hour?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: A Candleholder?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: All alone... far too arrogant, you are.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Feeble, ignorant, juvenile... you and these ants.
Her sword is already raised before She has finished Her sentence.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Jiang
steps.text: Chef—
Like the falling of the judge's gavel, or the crack of thunder in winter.
It is supposed to be a dining table, but it feels like a court of law.
All is silent.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: The dining table is no place for swords and bloodshed.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: Pick up your chopsticks, if you're here to eat. Don't let good food go to waste.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: And if you're not here to eat, you ought to get out.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Its parts... protect the humans of the Sui Regulator...

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: How ironic.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: We don't need you to tell us how to live our lives.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: On the other hand, I would suggest that you eat something. Hunger tends to make one grumpy.
The woman quietly pushes a steaming plate of buns in front of Ya.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: Enjoy, while it's hot.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: ...Hmph.
Ya looks coldly at the buns in front of Her, before turning to leave.

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: You're going?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: The Shanhaizhong's words were truth mixed with falsehood, but I will get my hands on what she promised to deliver to me.

spans.text: The Shanhaizhong's words were truth mixed with falsehood, but I
get my hands on what she promised to deliver to me.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: As for you... I've met many of Its incarnations, but none who answer my questions straightforwardly. What use is there for you people?

steps.name: Dignified Woman
steps.text: I will not say that an eye for an eye is unreasonable, but you should watch your step, in case someone has dug a pit for you.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Ridiculous.
Does She speak of the proxies, the Shanhaizhong, Herself, or the steaming plate of buns in front of Her?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Phew... good thing you showed up, Jun.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: It doesn't seem like She's here for any particular reason. Looks like She's been tricked by someone. Whether I'm here or not doesn't make much of a difference.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: It's not 'us' that She's after.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: ...*sigh*.

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: I just feel like She must have led a hard life.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: A road of hardship that only leads to even greater hardship.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Never mind that. Does my second oldest sister have business here in Baizao?

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: I have an appointment to keep.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: An appointment? How about you sit down and enjoy a meal, if you're not in a hurry—

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: I'm afraid it might be a little hard to sit down and enjoy anything...

steps.name: Jun
steps.text: Considering the burning smell coming from the kitchen.

steps.name: Yu
steps.text: Oh no... my roast fowlbeast!

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Stop.
The sound of paulownia seeds striking the ground rings clear through the faint morning autumn wind.
The slender woman in front of her has a nervous expression on her face, seemingly trying to hide her timidity at all costs.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: A visitor? When there is a general evacuation order throughout Baizao?

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Who are you? What business do you have in the Sky Mirror Pavilion?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I didn't mean to disturb—do you work here?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You must have seen the strange soldiers all over the city. They seem to have originated here.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Could you please tell me exactly what happened?

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: The Pavilion does not need an outsider meddling in its affairs. Besides, your identity is unknown, and you have trespassed into this place, armed.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: As Magistrate of Water for the Sky Mirror Pavilion, I cannot allow you to enter, whether it is for the safety of the Pavilion's archives, or for your own safety.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Turn back.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Magistrate of Water... what kind of position is that?

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: The Sky Mirror Pavilion is the first library of Yan. The Magistrate of Water is responsible for preventing fires.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: What are you doing in the Sky Mirror Pavilion, if you don't even know this?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I thought... a modern library wouldn't need a specific person to prevent fires anymore.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Indeed, you're right. Smart girl. Now, get out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm sorry... I mean no offense.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But I happen to know someone who used to work in Baizao's library...

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Who? What's your relationship?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's not important. It was many years ago.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Hm...
The aloof woman takes a few steps forward, lifting her lantern to look closely at Ch'en's face.
Ch'en instinctively takes a step back.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Enough. Nothing you say will matter.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Leave, if you have no business here. You'll regret it when the gates close.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But you're the only one here. Are you sure you'll be fine?

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: That's none of your business—why do you poke your nose into it?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Honestly... I came to clear out these monsters.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But when I saw this library, I felt like... like I've seen it in a dream. Like someone intentionally guided me here.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: A dream? Is that the best excuse you can come up with?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's not an excuse. Besides, I used to be a cop. I'm familiar with security work.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Please, trust me. Let me participate in the investigation.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: You... you're really a police?
Ch'en shows her ID.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: You're from Lungmen...

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Ch'en... Hui-chieh.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Ch'en Hui-chieh? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Don't think a piece of paper grants you free passage.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: I, Ch'en Chao-ch'ien, am the last of the Ch'ens. Have you come to mock the House of Ch'en? I'll never understand the imperial family's hobbies.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That means, you're—

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Still playing dumb? Don't you even know who your parents are?

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Your family never cared about the husband's side of the family when Princess Yanjing remarried, only to ruin the careers of the entire Ch'en family when she died...

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: What did my cousin do wrong? How could he possibly refuse?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Maybe you don't believe me... I can hardly believe it myself, but no one's ever told me so much about my family like that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I thought... I was the only one.

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: You didn't know? Then why have you come to the Sky Mirror Pavilion?
They stare at each other wordlessly, as though looking into blurry mirrors.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Enough... leave. A few nice words, that's all. You were willing to say them, and I appreciate it. Let's leave it at that.

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: I gave up asking more questions a long time ago. Thunder and rain are both gifts from Heaven. I should be grateful I still have a job—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Again.

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Wh-What? Didn't they disappear...?

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Oh no! The books!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll take you inside. It's faster that way. Excuse me.

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Stop! Such gall—w-wait!

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Insolent child—
Beneath the tall dome, densely packed bookshelves extend as far as the eye can see, reflecting in the floor like a massive, constantly expanding weiqi board.
Ink-colored scriptgeists wander amidst them, scattered like weiqi stones.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This is not good. The monsters here are much stronger than the ones I encountered at the gate.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's like they came flowing out of the shelves... what are they?

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Not shelves. Pages. Can't you tell?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Pages?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Get back!

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Hey, don't grab me—

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Fine, I suppose your intentions are righteous.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: What do you think, Candleholder Zuo? Is the news timely enough for you?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Going straight for the source of the geist trouble—even you Sui Regulator people haven't been able to react yet.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Do you believe me now?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Shut up and give it back!
The sound of metal clanging against metal.
Sparks fly as blades clash.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Hmph.
Mo Yi clenches her teeth as the soreness spreads from her hand to the rest of her arm.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: You blockhead... gotten stronger in the span of just a few days, haven't you?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What do you want, Shanhaizhong bandit?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Don't tell me you haven't noticed something's not right with the Sui Regulator?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What about this doll? Why did you steal it?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: It belongs to a proxy, just like the Book of Kung Fu. I believe... it has something to do with the vanished proxy.

spans.text: It belongs to a proxy, just like the
. I believe... it has something to do with the vanished proxy.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: As for taking it...

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Would you have cooperated and come with me to the Sky Mirror Pavilion, hard-headed as you are, if I didn't?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Out of the way!
He pushes so hard that it sends the doll in Mo Yi's arms flying.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: (Oh no!)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You won't—
Blades cross again in the blink of an eye.
The force sends both of them recoiling.
The blades vibrate and hum.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: —Look out!
The bookshelf collapses towards Mo Yi, the shockwave forcing her back.

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Stop! STOP!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Who are they...?)

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: You're swinging swords at each other when there are still monsters around?! And you toppled an entire shelf of books?!

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Out! GET OUT!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wait, be careful—

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Hmph...
It is unclear who moved first.
The balance is broken, and chaos breaks out.
Mo Yi turns towards the charging Magistrate of Water, angling her wrist to point her sword at her foe's shoulder.
Zuo Le's swing misses Mo Yi by inches, cutting the red rope tied to the wooden lock.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stand back!
Ch'en has no time to pull Ch'en Chao-ch'ien back. Almost by instinct, she draws Chi Xiao, and barely parries an attack, without even seeing who made it.
Sparks fly amidst the poorly lit bookshelves, accompanied by the piercing sound of clashing metal.

steps.name: Ch'en Chao-ch'ien
steps.text: Huh?
Mo Yi grabs Ch'en Chao-ch'ien by the collar and pulls her away from the scuffle.
Ch'en steps forward, her blade leading the way.
Zuo Le stands his ground—

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Stop!
The girl holds up the petite form of the Magistrate of Water, and turns her blade around.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (No! The token!)

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: You! Give the wooden lock back!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stop, all of you! Don't hurt the innocent!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You're... Lord Wei's niece?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Why is the token in your hands, Miss Ch'en? This is important to the Sui Regulator. You must return it at once!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lower your weapon!

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: What a mess...
